title: kubernetes input
description: Query and modify Kubernetes clusters through kubectl.

operation.description: The Kubernetes operation to perform. Use kubectl to run any kubectl command, including mutating commands.

resource.description: Kubernetes resource type, such as pods, deployments, services, or configmaps. Required for get and describe.

name.description: Name of a resource. Required for describe and optional for get.

all_namespaces.description: List a resource across all namespaces. Only supported by get.

label_selector.description: Label selector passed to get, for example app=api.

tail_lines.description: Maximum number of log lines to return.

since.description: Log duration window accepted by kubectl, for example 15m or 1h.

previous.description: Return logs from the previous container instance.

context.description: Optional kubeconfig context name. Defaults to the active context.

kubeconfig.description: Optional path to a kubeconfig file. Defaults to kubectl's normal kubeconfig resolution.

command.description: Arguments passed directly to kubectl for the kubectl operation, for example ["apply", "-f", "deployment.yaml"].
